title: MUIT Admissions Online Form 2026
vacancyDetails: Online admission forms for various undergraduate, postgraduate and diploma programmes
qualification: As per course – 10+2 for UG, Graduation for PG, etc.
applicationFee: Application / admission fee as per MUIT prospectus
selectionProcess: Online application → Merit / Entrance as applicable → Fee payment → Document verification
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, photo ID, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit official MUIT admissions website
2. Open Apply Online / Admission 2026
3. Register with email and mobile
4. Choose course, fill form, upload documents
5. Pay fee and download acknowledgement
shortDescription: MUIT Admissions Online Form 2026 – apply for UG/PG/diploma courses on the official Maharishi University admissions portal.
content:
Maharishi University of Information Technology (MUIT) has opened online admissions for session 2026.

Candidates can apply for multiple UG, PG and diploma programmes through the university admission portal. Check course-wise eligibility, fee structure and last dates on the official website before submitting the form.
